All the content on this channel is based on my 25 years of experience from working with 1000's of families. Not only will this help you be great parents but it will help your child learn important life skills and give them the best start to life. 

Hi my name is Cherrick Gordon and I am a Pediatric Physical Therapist with over 20 years of experience. My mission is to empower parents and caregivers with the knowledge and skills to lay their hands on their babies and make a positive impact. 

If you are concerned about Infant and Toddler gross motor skills and development, and you want evidence based hands on techniques to help your little one, It's here.
